# Bundled schema.json provenance

`schema.json` in this directory is the parsed GEOS schema, committed so that
external evaluators can run agents4geos without building GEOS first.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| GEOS commit | `d5787bd15` (v1.1.0-358-gd5787bd15) |
| Source `schema.xsd` | `<GEOS>/build/schema.xsd` on commit above |
| Generated by | `geos-tui` schema parser |
| Updated | 2026-05-21 |

## How agents4geos selects a schema

`agents4geos.tools.schema.get_schema()` resolves the schema in this order:

1. `$GEOS_SCHEMA` environment variable (path to a `schema.xsd`) — **always wins
   if set**. Real users with a local GEOS build should keep using this.
2. Cached `schema.json` (this file) — used when `$GEOS_SCHEMA` is unset.

## When to regenerate

Refresh this file when:

- GEOS adds or modifies XML elements that agents4geos needs to know about.
- An evaluator reports `Unknown element` errors against a recent GEOS version.

To regenerate against a newer GEOS build:

```bash
GEOS_SCHEMA=/path/to/GEOS/build/schema.xsd \
  uv run python -c "from agents4geos.tools.schema import get_schema; get_schema()"
# then copy the regenerated src/agents4geos/.cache/schema.json and commit
```
